name: Lie Detector
about: Scrum Master 3's LIVE Lie Detector, on demand: the real health of the system. It reads the lie detector's own report; green only when it is fresh and all 12 pin and seal probes pass, red if any of them fails or is missing, each one named.

facts.repin: run PIN AND RESEAL yourself, by hand in the terminal (your hand tool, your fingerprint once): it seals the vaults and the core and re-pins; then press RUN on The Pin and on Lie Detector
facts.rerun: cd ~/virtual_workspace/lryllm/lryllm/app && env -u PYTHONPATH PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 WID_ENV=localhost.rnd ~/virtual_workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "from core_engine import cebf; r = cebf.run(); print(r['at'], r['verdict'], r['pass'], 'pass', r['fail'], 'fail', r['no_data'], 'no data')"

card.pitch: The real health of the system: red if there are any problems
